continuity_scope: Nintendo of America English base Xenoblade Chronicles 3 for Nintendo Switch, released 29 July 2022. Character evidence is restricted to the six named core-party profiles published on Nintendo’s base-game store page. The Expansion Pass is excluded: Waves 2–3 add recruitable heroes Ino/Masha, while Wave 4 Future Redeemed is a prequel scenario with a new protagonist and cross-series connections. Xenoblade Chronicles, Xenoblade Chronicles 2, Xenoblade Chronicles X, their definitive/remaster editions, later patch states, and cross-title continuity are separate witnesses.
work_or_witnesses: Nintendo, Xenoblade Chronicles 3 base-game Nintendo Switch store page
Nintendo, Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Expansion Pass store page
coverage_rule: All individually named figures receiving a dedicated prose profile in the base-game page’s visible six-character core-party panel: Noah, Mio, Eunie, Taion, Lanz, and Sena. The page’s generic Heroes section describes an optional seventh member but does not name base-game heroes; no optional/recruitable hero is added. Classes, peoples, nations, colonies, weapons, Ouroboros, arts, worlds, and mechanics are dimensions/terms.
omissions: All named base-game figures absent from the dedicated six-profile panel, generic/optional Heroes, player-selected hero/party/class/Arts/gem/accessory choices, and all battle/story outcome assumptions.
Expansion Pass Wave 2 Ino, Wave 3 Masha, Wave 4 Future Redeemed characters/scenario/systems, DLC items/outfits/challenge content, and any post-launch patch/amiibo effects.
All other Xenoblade titles, their remasters/expansions, cross-title identity claims, other localizations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: Nintendo’s store page is a promotional base-game character panel, not a full cast/codex or complete story transcript; pass-complete is limited to its six explicit profiles.
The page describes a six-character core party and player-customizable control/classes, but it does not establish every story grouping, optional hero choice, or ending as fixed.
Future Redeemed explicitly connects all three main Xenoblade games and takes place before Xenoblade Chronicles 3; it is deliberately not merged into base-game character records.
The live store now displays Switch 2 compatibility and later DLC, neither of which revises the July 2022 base-game character witness.
evidence_basis: Nintendo first-party store pages only: direct base-game character profiles/system descriptions and the official Expansion Pass listing for DLC/prequel boundaries. No fan source is used as canonical evidence.
